items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: It's an old Yardhunt. Yeah, he plays better than all the others, I would say.

ctx.x: What about George Lewis's band there? Do they play the same as they played Preservation Hall?

Yeah, I would say so. But they don't have the same line-up. They have a different piano player and they don't have a bass. Actually, he sounds better with the white piano player. It's an old Yardhunt. Yeah, he plays better than all the others, I would say. But the others can't keep the right chords and the right beat all the time. None of the guys in the band likes Eddie Connan. I don't know why they play with that. Because they always ask me to sit in and they always say that she's bad all the time. And she…
She seems soft to me. She doesn't like to play New Orleans music? No.
